name: Mazatlán
registryAssessment: The Instituto Catastral del Estado de Sinaloa (ICES) is the state cadastral custodian and publishes an official Mazatlán manzanero viewer route. The public viewer is documented as an official first-party route, but its iframe backend was unavailable during this attempt; no claim of complete current parcel coverage is made.

officialSources.role: Instituto Catastral del Estado de Sinaloa official site
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200; identifies ICES as the state cadastral institution and links cadastral information, procedures, and territorial viewer services.

officialSources.role: Official ICES Mazatlán manzanero viewer route
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200; page embeds the Mazatlán cadastral manzanero viewer at http://ices-oblix.sinaloa.gob.mx/visores/mazatlanmanzanero/.
HTTP 200; current JavaScript/configuration exposes a catastral-information workflow keyed by ClaveCatastral, with payment-required form endpoints; it is not an anonymous parcel geometry API.

officialSources.role: Official Sinaloa public property registry portal
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200; lists the Registro Público de la Propiedad y del Comercio office for the municipality of Mazatlan.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The official Mazatlán viewer backend returned Cloudflare 522 during the request attempt, and the cadastral-information portal requires a cadastral key and payment workflow. No parcel polygon was fabricated or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official ICES Mazatlán cadastral/manzanero viewer and Sinaloa cadastral portals.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The first-party route and cadastral custodian were verified, but the live viewer data service was not available to this attempt and complete current citywide parcel coverage was not independently proven.

sourceSchema.nativeIdentity: The public portal exposes ClaveCatastral as the cadastral lookup key; no parcel feature schema or stable geometry identity was available anonymously.
